annotation.authors_or_issuer: Menon, C.; Carta, S.; Foerster, F.; Holthaus, P.
key_provisions_or_claims: Presents EETAS, a structured workshop methodology to improve public understanding of ethical complexities of assistive robots.
Presents DEETAS, a digital design-centric variant for users reluctant to join workshops.
Pilot and usability studies indicate the methods engage users and improve understanding.
End-user voices should feed into robot development and in guiding preferred robot behaviours.
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper presenting EETAS, a structured-workshop methodology, and DEETAS, a digital design-centric variant, for improving public understanding of ethical complexities of assistive robots and involving end users in development. Pilot and usability studies indicate the approaches are effective at engaging users.
annotation.title_clean: Improving Public Engagement with Ethical Complexities of Assistive Robots
annotation.title_en: Improving Public Engagement with Ethical Complexities of Assistive Robots
annotation.venue: Computer-Human Interaction Research and Applications (CHIRA 2021/2022), CCIS vol. 1882, Springer
